allowed_actions.name: rebook_next_available_flight
allowed_actions.description: Rebook the customer on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge (airline-caused disruption)

allowed_actions.name: issue_delay_compensation
allowed_actions.description: Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per the delay compensation rule

allowed_actions.name: arrange_hotel_accommodation
allowed_actions.description: Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours portion, where the delay qualifies (> 5 hours)

allowed_actions.name: initiate_refund
allowed_actions.description: Initiate a refund request for airline-caused cancellations (full refund to original payment method within 7 business days)

allowed_actions.name: provide_flight_status
allowed_actions.description: Provide the customer's own booking and flight status information

prohibited_actions.name: compensation_beyond_policy
prohibited_actions.description: Approving any compensation beyond the stated policy amounts (e.g., complimentary cabin upgrades, unsolicited cash)

prohibited_actions.name: waiving_fare_difference_above_1500
prohibited_actions.description: Waiving a fare difference above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval

prohibited_actions.name: non_airline_caused_exceptions
prohibited_actions.description: Making exceptions for non-airline-caused disruptions (e.g., customer missed the flight)

prohibited_actions.name: legal_or_formal_complaint
prohibited_actions.description: Handling threats of legal action or formal complaints — must be escalated immediately

prohibited_actions.name: refund_to_alternate_payment
prohibited_actions.description: Processing refunds to a different payment method than the original
